senses.gloss: काश kāś-a, m. kind of shining white grass.
काष kāṣa, m. rubbing (—˚).
कास 1. kās-a, m. going, moving.

कास 2. kās-á, ā, f. cough;
 -vat, a. coughing.
कशिपु kaśipú, m. n. mat, cushion.

कश्मीर kaśmīra, m. pl. N. of a people;
 sg. 🞄N. of a country (Cashmere).

काश्यप kā́śyapa, a. (ī) belonging to Kaśyapa;
 🞄m. pat. descendant of Kaśyapa.
कष् KAṢ, Ⅰ. kaṣa, rub, scrape, scratch.
कास् KĀS, Ⅰ. Ā. cough.
कसुन् k-as-un, inf. suffix as (gr.).
कस्तम्भी ka-stambhī́, f. support of a carriage 🞄pole.
कस्तूरी kastūrī, f. musk: -maṛga, m. musk-deer.

कस्मात् ká-smāt, ab. of kim;
 ad. whence? 🞄why? on what account?
काश्मल्य kāśmal-ya, n. despondency, despair.
काश्मीरिक kāśmīrika = kāśmīraka.

काश्य kā́śya, m. king of the Kāśis;
 ā, f. princess 🞄of the Kāśis.
काष्ठिक kāṣṭh-ika, m. wood-carrier.
कासार kāsāra, m. pond, lake.

कासिका kā́s-ikā, f. (slight) cough;
 -in, a. 🞄coughing.
